latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Swarms AI skill for building and orchestrating multi-agent systems via Swarms API.
- Supports single agents and large-scale swarms (3–10,000+ agents) with 20+ architecture patterns.
- Includes quick-start and reference for individual agents, multi-agent swarms, and Solana token launches.
- Details parameters for agent configuration, swarm types, authentication, and integration best practices.
- Provides a resource map for deeper guides on API architecture, tool integration, streaming, tokenization, and marketplace features.
